description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeTerminationService class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling employee termination-related services. It includes methods for retrieving termination reasons and manages a DAO for database interactions, utilizing traits for normalization functionality.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationService
classes.description: Service class providing employee termination functionalities, including retrieving termination reasons from the DAO and normalizing data models.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmployeeTerminationDao instance used for database operations related to employee termination.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonsArray
methods.description: Fetches a list of termination reasons from the DAO and normalizes the data into an array format.
